summary.intent: Complete Phase 38 context capture (retire deprecated web services) and run a full discussion session for Phase 39 (user-configurable vault parameters — recycle bin retention, delete behavior, and file versioning defaults).
summary.outcome: Phase 38 CONTEXT.md was written and committed. Phase 39 CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md were created after a structured discussion covering all four implementation areas. Phase 38 planning was launched as a background agent in parallel.

repo: BYO-IPFS config already stores user settings in encrypted vault metadata on IPFS via ByoIpfsConfig — this is the established pattern to follow for Phase 39 vault settings storage.
Bin retention is currently a server-side env var (RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS=30) exposed via /vault/config API — moving it to client-side vault metadata is a breaking change in responsibility.
MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE=10 and VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS=15min are hardcoded in two places: file-metadata.service.ts and sdk-core/src/file/index.ts — both will need updating.
Delete behavior is always soft-delete to bin with no toggle; hard-delete bypass is a net-new control.
Settings page has exactly 3 tabs (Linked Methods, Security, Storage); Storage tab currently holds only BYO-IPFS connection settings.
Phase 38 established SDK migration pattern: direct SDK imports, explicit params, delete both service files, update barrel file — follow useSharedWriteOps.ts as the reference.

code.finding: ByoIpfsConfig type demonstrates the pattern for storing user preferences in encrypted vault metadata on IPFS — Phase 39 vault settings should follow this shape.
Settings page with 3 tabs; vault parameter controls (retention, delete behavior, versioning) will be added here, likely as a new tab or within Storage.

workflow: GSD manager supports parallel execution: Phase 38 planning was spawned as a background agent while Phase 39 discussion ran inline — useful for keeping pipeline moving.
Todo cross-referencing via 'todo match-phase' can return false positives on generic terms (retention, version, cooldown) — manually verifying matches before folding is important.
Discuss mode routes to assumptions vs interview mode based on config; the assumptions path scouts the codebase first and surfaces evidence-backed assumptions rather than asking open questions.

friction: Todo matching returned unrelated results for Phase 39 — generic keywords (retention, version, cooldown) matched todos with no actual relevance to vault parameter configuration, requiring manual dismissal.
